Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase! The Indian players make their way to the middle, followed by Tammy Beaumont and Lauren Winfield. Jhulan Goswami will start with the ball.

England's Women were brilliant with the ball. They just kept on coming and coming and did not give anything away to India. Katherine Brunt and Anya Shrubsole were just terrific at the start while Kate Cross maintained the control in the middle overs along with Natalie Sciver. But the star of the show was yet again. Sophie Ecclestone. She picked up three wickets and was once again the pick of the bowlers. They need just 202 runs to win and they have the batting line-up to chase this down. The run chase begins in a while. Do join us for that.

India Women did not start off too well as they lost the debutant, Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana early on in the innings. Then came a small partnership between Mithali Raj and Punam Raut. Both were slow in their approach and the runs were not coming. Just when Raut decided to attack, she fell and Harmanpreet Kaur followed her soon after. Deepti Sharma played a good little hand but it was Mithali Raj's knock that helped India get to 200. There was nothing much from the lower order and India have just posted 201 on the board.

End of a very good bowling performance from England Women! They will be pleased with the effort and they will back their batters to chase down 202 in their 50 overs. India Women, on the other hand, would be disappointed as they might feel that they have got a par score on this wicket and they would need to bowl really well if they want to defend this.

OUT! STUMPED! That decision took a while, because it could have gone either way. But the third umpire has given it as OUT. A full length ball, outside off, back of the hand this time. She misses her shot, as the keeper collects it sharply and knocks the bails off. This has gone upstairs to confirm. The replays are seen repetitively, as the umpire finally signals it OUT.

On a length, on off, pushed to covers again.
Full length ball, on off, Mandhana leans and drives it to cover.
Good length ball, on off, Verma defends it to third man and jogs to the other side for a single.
Another full length delivery, outside off, Verma comes forward and drives it to cover but straight to the fielder.
Full length delivery, on off, Verma plays it to mid on.
A touch fuller, on off, Mandhana drives it to cover, but cannot find the gap.
A length ball, on leg, Mandhana tucks it to mid on.
Fraction short, on off, Verma pulls it awkwardly towards square leg and gets a single.
Touch and run! A length ball, on off, Mandhana pushes it to cover and takes off for a single.
A length ball, on off, Mandhana works it to cover.
Good length ball, on off, Mandhana stays back and pushes it to cover.
A length ball, on off, Verma defends it to the off side.
FOUR! What a shot! The debutant gets the first boundary of the game. A full length ball, on off, Verma flicks it between mid on and mid-wicket, as the ball races towards the boundary.
A low full toss, on off, Verma guides it to mid off.
Good length ball, on off, nips in. Verma is solid in her defense.
A length ball, on middle, Mandhana clips it to square leg for a single.
An inswinger, coming in from outside leg. Mandhana pushes it to cover.
Who will bowl from the other end? Anya Shrubsole it is.
A length ball, on the pads, Mandhana flicks it through mid-wicket and gets a single. A tidy over by Katherine Brunt.
Fullish, on off, Verma tucks it to the leg side, and gets off the mark on her first delivery. A run taken.
A length ball, on off, Mandhana pushes it through cover and gets off the mark. Single taken.
On a length, on off, Mandhana stays back and pushes it gently towards mid off.
A length ball, on off, Mandhana drives it to mid off.
Starts with a full toss, on off, Smriti Mandhana pushes it with soft hands towards mid off.
We are all set to begin! The England Women stride out to the middle, followed by Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana. Katherine Brunt will start with the ball.

Update 1016 local (0916 GMT) - Not the greatest of news as the pitch is under the covers right now. It is not raining but it is dark and overcast. There is a forecast of rain throughout this day. Let's hope that the rain stays away and we get a prompt start. Stay with us.

It has been a good last few days for Shafali Verma. She made her Test debut against England in the one-off Test and now she is all set to make her ODI debut. Shafali had a great Test debut, scoring half-centuries in both the innings and it won't be a surprise if she continues her form. She is an attacking player and it will be interesting to see if she can make an impact on ODI debut.

Hello and a warm welcome for the first of three ODI matches between England Women and India Women. The Indian side showed courage and determination in the Test prior to this game, as they worked hard to take a draw out of it. That will work as a confidence booster, coming into this game. While the English side were on top, they let India off the hook and failed to capitalise on their position. Can England start with a victory today? Or will the Indian side come with a burst of momentum? We are as confused as you are, all we can do is wait. Stay tuned for the toss and more updates.
